metrics.a: observable expectations; annotation=test RMSE / training-output SD
metrics.b: absolute paired QRC output gap; 10th-90th seed percentiles, not CI or global D_d
metrics.c: absolute worst-case scalar error; specified readout, not trained

emulation.omitted_from_this_layout: N5 window and feature panels; original source, figures and text results retained
emulation.retained: Fixed laser excerpt; all 24 paired controls; all analytic copy counts; all N5 rows in ledger
emulation.style_reference: User-supplied arXiv:2608.25511v1, Fig.5, p.7; grouping only

independent_verification.scope: Every stored test score and target; saved-readout/channel reconstruction sampled at five fixed rows per fitted model and cell. Direction checks are separate from verification success, not universal superiority or hardware validation.

laser.scope: Coupling variation conditional on one measured record

layout.label_placement: NARMA model names and target legend above data axes; laser condition titles outside axes; lower-panel legends in aligned footer regions.

narma_dense_replay.algorithm: Shared chronological prefixes of independent fixed-state replays; one fitted readout per root and window; no interpolation, smoothing, or new loss-rate selection.
narma_dense_replay.interval: 10th-90th percentiles of 24 root-level scores; not confidence intervals
narma_dense_replay.metric: Test RMSE divided by training-target standard deviation
narma_dense_replay.scope: Post hoc every-window extension on the unchanged archived 24-root cohort; not a fresh replication or new model/loss selection.

specification.numerical_addendum: After the documented first-root diagnostic, archived metrics and first-trace predictions use an absolute 1e-5 cross-runtime bound. Exact alpha/gamma/features, strict target identity, and strict same-runtime feature equivalence are unchanged. Initial failed attempt remains archived; no fit or outcome selection changed.

numerical_reproducibility.interpretation: Frozen and optimized replay agree exactly on this host. Archived differences are concentrated in ill-conditioned alpha=1e-8 normal-equation fits; no targets, selected settings, physics or splits were changed. Initial strict cross-runtime gate failed; no extension result was published.

specification.scope: Post hoc every-window extension on the unchanged archived 24-root cohort; not a fresh replication or new model/loss selection.

scope.direct_test_row_positions: first, middle, last scored row of every root

narma_history_display.guide_interpretation: At d=10 the quantized input at t-9 first enters the window for predicting y_(t+1). This exposes the lag used by NARMA10's explicit input interaction; it is not a claim of complete history or an isolated causal effect.

narma_trace.input_units: NARMA recursion drive 0.2*u[t]; hardware receives quantized u[t]

narma_trace_display.description: First 48 samples of the original fixed 96-sample excerpt; full traces retained, identical viewport and original y limits for both models.

omitted_from_display: Quadratic curves omitted at author request; all 4/12-input results retained below and in manuscript prose.

panels.b: 12-root paired QRC gap above separate analytic convergence
panels.c: synthetic NARMA10 predictions stacked above 24-root history restriction

replay_display: Labels describe accessible history: QRC last d inputs, QRC full history, QELM last 4 inputs. Recent inputs include the current input. The restricted QRC is reset for every prediction; only the last d inputs are processed anew, with a separately refitted readout for each d. One computed point for every integer d=1..48; the linear display focuses on d=1..20, retaining all 24 original fresh roots at every d. Straight connections, no smoothing or interpolated observations. Full-history QRC median is a red dashed empirical reference, not a floor. QELM only has a four-input estimate here.
scope: Full source excerpts retained; NARMA display zooms into the first 48 samples. No smoothing/cohort pooling. Root bands are 10th-90th percentiles, not CI. Replay costs extra evolution. Analytic floor does not bound sampled laser or NARMA errors.
